title: Towards sustainable PMR for organic contaminant removal from municipal wastewater

Veronica Cozzolino, Gerardo Coppola, Sudip Chakraborty, Giovanni Chiappetta, Alessio Siciliano, Carlo Limonti, Giulia Maria Curcio, Catia Algieri, Vincenza Calabrò
Persistent organic pollutants (POPs) resist degradation, posing health and environmental risks. Photocatalytic membrane reactors offer efficient POP breakdown and easy catalyst recovery, enabling safe, reusable water for agriculture and beyond.
